## Checklist

- [ ] I ran `python3 scripts/build.py` and committed the updated `dist/` files.
- [ ] `python3 scripts/validate.py` passes.
- [ ] `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/scripts` passes.
- [ ] If this is a release: I ran `python3 scripts/bump_version.py X.Y.Z` (last number for content and fixes, middle number for new features).
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` says what changed, in plain words.
- [ ] No personal data: no one's real writing samples, voice files, notes, drafts or email addresses.
- [ ] Sources are credited and linked, and nothing is copied from Wikipedia or other people's skills.
